explanation:
**It is said that Japan's food self-sufficiency rate is low.**

---

- **食料 / 食糧（しょくりょう）** — kango noun, "food, provisions." 食料 is everyday food supplies; 食糧 leans toward grain/staple food. Chinese 食糧 has a narrower meaning (grain only) — partial false friend. [JLPT N2]
- **自給率（じきゅうりつ）** — kango noun, "self-sufficiency rate." 自給 (self-supply) + 率 (rate). Collocates with 食料, エネルギー. [JLPT N2]
- **低（ひく）い** — い-adjective, "low." Opposite: 高い. [JLPT N5]
- **〜と言われる** — と (quotation) + 言われる (passive of 言う). "It is said that..." Impersonal passive expressing a widely held view. [JLPT N4]

**Eat one grape.**

---

- **粒（つぶ）** — noun, counter suffix for small round objects (grains, drops, pills). Wago. As counter: 一粒（ひとつぶ）, 二粒（ふたつぶ）. [JLPT N2]
- **ぶどう** — noun, "grapes." Kana is standard; kanji 葡萄 is rare. [JLPT N3]
- **一粒（ひとつぶ）** — counter: one grain/one small round object. [JLPT N2]
- **食（た）べる** — 他動詞, "to eat." [JLPT N5]

**Throw away vegetable scraps.**

---

- **くず** — noun, "scraps, waste, refuse, trimmings." Wago. Refers to unusable leftover parts (peels, stems, ends). Also means "trash person" colloquially. Kanji: 屑. [JLPT N2]
- **野菜（やさい）の** — 野菜 = vegetables. の marks association. [JLPT N5]
- **捨（す）てる** — 他動詞, "to throw away, to discard." [JLPT N4]

**Serve as the manager/coach of a sports team.**

---

- **監督（かんとく）** — kango noun, "director, supervisor, manager, coach." In sports: team manager/head coach. In film: director. Chinese 監督 is a true friend. [JLPT N2]
- **スポーツチームの** — スポーツ (sports) + チーム (team) + の. [JLPT N3]
- **務（つと）める** — 他動詞, "to serve (in a role), to fulfill (a duty)." Collocates with 役, 教師, 社長. [JLPT N2]

**Harvest crops.**

---

- **収穫（しゅうかく）** — kango noun/suru-verb, "harvest." Also figurative: "results, gains" (収穫がある = "it was productive"). Chinese 収穫 is a true friend. [JLPT N2]
- **農作物（のうさくもつ）** — kango noun, "agricultural products, crops." [JLPT N2]
- **〜を収穫する** — suru-verb used 他動詞. [JLPT N2]

**Aomori Prefecture is famous as a production area for apples.**

---

- **産地（さんち）** — kango noun, "production area, region known for producing something." 産 (produce) + 地 (place). Often 〜の産地. [JLPT N2]
- **青森県（あおもりけん）** — proper noun, "Aomori Prefecture" (northern Honshu, famous for apples). [JLPT N2]
- **〜として** — particle, "as, in the capacity of." [JLPT N3]
- **有名（ゆうめい）だ** — な-adjective, "famous." [JLPT N4]

**Buy land and build a house.**

---

- **土地（とち）** — kango noun, "land, plot." Specifically real estate land. Chinese 土地 has broader meaning (territory) — partial overlap. [JLPT N2]
- **買（か）って** — 買う (他動詞, "to buy") + て-form (sequential action). [JLPT N5]
- **家（いえ）を建（た）てる** — 建てる (他動詞, "to build"). Counterpart 自動詞: 建つ. [JLPT N4]

**Many warehouses line the port.**

---

- **倉庫（そうこ）** — kango noun, "warehouse, storehouse." Chinese 倉庫 is a true friend. [JLPT N2]
- **港（みなと）** — noun, "port, harbor." [JLPT N3]
- **多（おお）くの** — 多く ("many") + の. Modifies 倉庫. [JLPT N4]
- **並（なら）んでいる** — 並ぶ (自動詞, "to line up, to be arranged") + ている (state). Counterpart 他動詞: 並べる. [JLPT N3]

**Release the hostages.**

---

- **解放（かいほう）** — kango suru-verb/noun, "release, liberation, freeing." Used for hostages, prisoners, oppressed groups. Chinese 解放 is a true friend. [JLPT N2]
- **人質（ひとじち）** — kango noun, "hostage." [JLPT N2]
- **〜を解放する** — 他動詞 usage. [JLPT N2]

**In many areas, garbage is sorted into combustible and non-combustible and then collected.**

---

- **収集（しゅうしゅう）** — kango suru-verb/noun, "collection, gathering." Collocates with ごみ, データ, 情報. Chinese 收集 is a true friend. [JLPT N2]
- **可燃（かねん）・不燃（ふねん）** — kango nouns, "combustible / non-combustible." Standard Japanese waste-sorting categories. [JLPT N2]
- **分別（ぶんべつ）して** — 分別する (他動詞, "to sort, classify") + て-form (method). [JLPT N2]
- **地域（ちいき）が多（おお）い** — "there are many areas." [JLPT N3]

**This overseas business trip is planned to be a stay of about one month.**

---

- **滞在（たいざい）** — kango suru-verb/noun, "stay, sojourn." Implies a relatively short-term stay, as opposed to 居住 (long-term residence). [JLPT N2]
- **海外出張（かいがいしゅっちょう）** — 海外 (overseas) + 出張 (business trip). [JLPT N2]
- **約（やく）１ヵ月（いっかげつ）** — 約 (about) + 1ヶ月 (one month). Note: ヵ is a small katakana ケ. [JLPT N4]
- **〜になる予定（よてい）だ** — になる (will become) + 予定 (plan/schedule). "Is planned to be." [JLPT N3]

"I sent the documents on the earliest morning flight, so I think they will arrive tomorrow morning."

---

- **便（びん）** — kango noun, "flight, mail service, delivery." Here: airline flight. Also: 郵便 (mail). Counter: 第一便, 最終便. [JLPT N2]
- **朝一番（あさいちばん）の** — 朝 (morning) + 一番 (first) + の. "The very first in the morning." [JLPT N3]
- **書類（しょるい）を送（おく）った** — 書類 (documents) + 送る (他動詞, "to send") + た (past). [JLPT N4]
- **〜から** — conjunction, "because, since." [JLPT N5]
- **〜と思（おも）います** — と (quotation) + 思う ("to think") + ます (polite). [JLPT N4]

**Our university has excellent sports facilities.**

---

- **設備（せつび）** — kango noun, "equipment, facilities." Physical installations for a specific purpose. 充実（じゅうじつ）している is the standard collocation meaning "well-equipped." [JLPT N2]
- **スポーツ** — noun, "sports." [JLPT N5]
- **充実（じゅうじつ）している** — 充実する (kango suru-verb, "to be well-developed,充实") + ている (state). [JLPT N2]

**For this robot, the university students did everything from design to manufacture.**

---

- **設計（せっけい）** — kango noun/suru-verb, "design, plan (structural/engineering)." Used for buildings, machines, systems. 設 (set up) + 計 (plan). [JLPT N2]
- **製作（せいさく）** — kango noun/suru-verb, "manufacture, production" (of physical objects). See entry 596. [JLPT N2]
- **〜から〜まで** — pattern, "from ... to ..." (range). [JLPT N5]
- **すべて** — noun/adverb, "all, everything." [JLPT N4]
- **行（おこな）った** — 行う (他動詞, "to do, to carry out") + た (past). Formal alternative to する. [JLPT N3]

**[製作] — to manufacture/produce {machines / robots / furniture ...}.**

---

- **製作 / 制作（せいさく）** — kango suru-verb/noun, "production, manufacture." 製作 is for physical objects (machines, robots, furniture, films). 制作 is for creative/artistic works (TV programs, art, software). The distinction is subtle but tested. [JLPT N2]
- **機械（きかい）** — noun, "machine." [JLPT N4]
- **製作する** — 他動詞 usage, takes を. [JLPT N2]

**This company manufactures cars.**

---

- **製造（せいぞう）** — kango suru-verb/noun, "manufacturing, production" (industrial mass production). 製 = manufacture + 造 = build. Used with cars, electronics, food products. Distinct from 製作 (individual/custom production). [JLPT N2]
- **会社（かいしゃ）** — noun, "company." [JLPT N5]
- **車（くるま）を製造（せいぞう）している** — 製造する (他動詞) + ている (ongoing state/activity). [JLPT N2]

**To construct {houses / bridges ...}.**

---

- **建築（けんちく）** — kango suru-verb/noun, "construction, architecture" (of buildings, bridges, large structures). More formal than 建てる; used for planned, engineered construction. 建 (build) + 築 (construct). [JLPT N2]
- **家（いえ）** — noun, "house." [JLPT N5]
- **橋（はし）** — noun, "bridge." [JLPT N3]
- **〜を建築する** — 他動詞 usage. [JLPT N2]

**This ski resort makes artificial snow fall.**

---

- **人工（じんこう）** — kango noun, "artificial, man-made." 人 (human) + 工 (craft). Also means "population" in compounds like 人工密度. Chinese 人工 has similar meaning but broader use. [JLPT N2]
- **スキー場（じょう）** — スキー (ski) + 場 (place). [JLPT N3]
- **人工の雪（ゆき）** — 人工の (artificial) + 雪 (snow). "Artificial snow." [JLPT N3]
- **降（ふ）らせている** — 降る (自動詞, "to fall" [snow/rain]) + せる (causative) + ている (ongoing). "Make snow fall." Causative shows intentional action. [JLPT N3]

**Apply pressure to air to compress it.**

---

- **圧力（あつりょく）** — kango noun, "pressure" (physical force per unit area). 圧 = press + 力 = force. Chinese 压力 is a true friend for physics meaning. [JLPT N2]
- **空気（くうき）** — noun, "air." [JLPT N4]
- **圧力（あつりょく）を加（くわ）えて** — 加える (他動詞, "to add, to apply") + て-form (method). [JLPT N3]
- **圧縮（あつしゅく）する** — kango suru-verb, "to compress." 圧 (press) + 縮 (shrink). [JLPT N2]

**When electrical stimulation is applied to the muscle, it twitches.**

---

- **刺激（しげき）** — kango noun, "stimulation, stimulus." 刺 = prick + 激 = intense. Used in both physical and psychological contexts. Chinese 刺激 is a true friend. [JLPT N2]
- **筋肉（きんにく）** — kango noun, "muscle." [JLPT N2]
- **電気（でんき）で** — 電気 (electricity) + で (means/instrument). [JLPT N5]
- **刺激（しげき）を与（あた）えると** — 与える (他動詞, "to give, to apply") + と (conditional, "when"). Counterpart 自動詞: 与えられる (passive). [JLPT N3]
- **ぴくりと動（うご）く** — ぴくりと (onomatopoeia, slight twitch/jerk) + 動く (自動詞, "to move"). [JLPT N3]

**A forest fire was caused by the heat from friction between tree branches.**

---

- **摩擦（まさつ）** — kango noun, "friction, rubbing." 摩 = rub + 擦 = scrape. Used in physics (friction between surfaces) and figuratively (social friction). Chinese 摩擦 is a true friend. [JLPT N2]
- **木（き）の枝（えだ）** — 木 (tree) + の + 枝 (branch). [JLPT N4/N3]
- **摩擦の熱（ねつ）で** — 摩擦 (friction) + の + 熱 (heat) + で (cause). "Due to the heat of friction." [JLPT N3]
- **森林火災（しんりんかさい）が起こ（おこ）った** — 森林火災 (forest fire) + が + 起こる (自動詞, "to occur, to happen"). Counterpart 他動詞: 起こす. [JLPT N2/N3]

**It is important not only to assert your own opinions but also to try thinking from the other person's standpoint.**

---

- **立場（たちば）** — kango noun, "standpoint, position, situation." 立 (stand) + 場 (place). Figurative: one's perspective or situation in a social context. Not just physical position. [JLPT N2]
- **自分（じぶん）の意見（いけん）を主張（しゅちょう）するだけでなく** — 自分 (self) + 意見 (opinion) + 主張する (to assert) + だけでなく (not only). [JLPT N3/N2]
- **相手（あいて）の立場（たちば）に立（た）って** — 相手 (other person) + 立場 (standpoint) + に立つ (to take/adopt a position) + て-form. "Putting yourself in the other person's shoes." [JLPT N2]
- **考（かんが）えてみることも大事（だいじ）だ** — 考える (to think) + てみる (try doing) + こと (nominalizer) + も (also) + 大事だ (is important). [JLPT N3]

**Decide the roles for work.**

---

- **役割（やくわり）** — kango noun, "role, part, function." 役 (role/duty) + 割 (share/division). Standard collocation: 役割を果たす ("fulfill a role"). [JLPT N2]
- **仕事（しごと）の** — 仕事 (work, job) + の. [JLPT N5]
- **決（き）める** — 他動詞, "to decide, to determine." Counterpart 自動詞: 決まる. [JLPT N4]

**We are sharing the workload with colleagues and progressing with the work.**

---

- **分担（ぶんたん）** — kango suru-verb/noun, "division of labor, sharing (tasks/responsibilities)." 分 (divide) + 担 (carry/shoulder). Collocates with する, を맡う. [JLPT N2]
- **同僚（どうりょう）と** — 同僚 (colleague, coworker) + と (with). [JLPT N2]
- **分担（ぶんたん）して** — 分担する + て-form (manner/state). "Sharing the work." [JLPT N2]
- **仕事（しごと）を進（すす）めている** — 進める (他動詞, "to advance, to progress") + ている (ongoing). Counterpart 自動詞: 進む. [JLPT N3]

**I am in charge of sales at the company.**

---

- **担当（たんとう）** — kango noun/suru-verb, "person in charge, assignment, being in charge of." 担 (carry) + 当 (face/handle). Very common workplace term. Collocates with をする, を 맡う. [JLPT N2]
- **会社（かいしゃ）で** — 会社 (company) + で (location of action). [JLPT N5]
- **営業（えいぎょう）を担当（たんとう）している** — 営業 (sales, business) + を担当している (be in charge of). [JLPT N2]

**The prime minister changed/was replaced.**

---

- **交替 / 交代（こうたい）** — kango suru-verb/noun, "change, replacement, alternation." Both kanji forms exist; 交代 is more common. Used for shift changes, personnel replacements, political transitions. Chinese 交替 and 交代 have similar meanings. [JLPT N2]
- **首相（しゅしょう）** — kango noun, "prime minister." [JLPT N2]
- **交代（こうたい）した** — 交代する (自動詞, "to change, to be replaced") + た (past). Can also be 他動詞: 交代させる. [JLPT N2]

**I attended my relative's wedding on behalf of my father.**

---

- **代理（だいり）** — kango noun, "proxy, acting on behalf of, substitute." 代 (substitute) + 理 (handle). Standard pattern: 〜の代理で ("on behalf of ~"). Chinese 代理 is a true friend. [JLPT N2]
- **父（ちち）の代理（だいり）で** — 父 (father, humble) + の代理で ("on behalf of"). [JLPT N2]
- **親戚（しんせき）の結婚式（けっこんしき）に出席（しゅっせき）した** — 親戚 (relatives) + 結婚式 (wedding ceremony) + に出席した (attended). 出席する is 他動詞, takes に. [JLPT N2/N3]

**The referee blew the whistle and the game began.**

---

- **審判（しんばん）** — kango noun, "referee, umpire, judgment." In sports: the official/referee. In law: court judgment. 審 (examine) + 判 (judge). [JLPT N2]
- **笛（ふえ）を吹（ふ）いて** — 笛 (whistle, flute) + を吹く (他動詞, "to blow") + て-form (sequential action). [JLPT N3/N4]
- **試合（しあい）が始（はじ）まった** — 試合 (game, match) + が始まる (自動詞, "to begin") + た (past). Counterpart 他動詞: 始める. [JLPT N3]

**Predict the results based on data.**

---

- **予測（よそく）** — kango suru-verb/noun, "prediction, forecast" (based on analysis/data). 予 (pre-) + 測 (measure/guess). Used for weather, market trends, outcomes. Differs from 予想 (more intuitive). [JLPT N2]
- **データに基づ（もと）いて** — データ (data) + に基づく ("to be based on") + て-form. Based on objective data. [JLPT N2]
- **結果（けっか）を予測（よそく）する** — 結果 (result) + を予測する (to predict). 他動詞 usage. [JLPT N2]

**In this experiment, contrary to expectations, good data could not be obtained.**

---

- **予期（よき）** — kango suru-verb/noun, "expectation, anticipation." 予 (pre-) + 期 (expect). More formal than 予想; often used with 〜に反する ("contrary to"). [JLPT N2]
- **実験（じっけん）** — kango noun, "experiment." [JLPT N3]
- **予期（よき）に反（はん）し** — 予期 (expectation) + に反する (to go against, contrary to) + し (conjunctive form). "Contrary to expectations." [JLPT N2]
- **いいデータが得（え）られなかった** — いいデータ (good data) + が得られる (自動詞, "to be obtained, to be acquired") + なかった (negative past). 得る counterpart 他動詞: 得る can also be used transitively. [JLPT N2]

**It is not good to judge people by their appearance or job title.**

---

- **判断（はんだん）** — kango suru-verb/noun, "judgment, decision, assessment." 判 (judge) + 断 (decide). Pattern: 〜で判断する ("judge by ~"). [JLPT N2]
- **外見（がいけん）や肩書（かたがき）で** — 外見 (appearance) + や (and/or) + 肩書 (title, job title) + で (basis/criteria). [JLPT N2]
- **人（ひと）を判断（はんだん）する** — 人 (person) + を判断する (to judge). 他動詞 usage. [JLPT N2]
- **〜のはよくない** — nominalizer の + は (topic) + よくない (is not good). "It's not good to..." [JLPT N4]

**Public evaluation of this film is high.**

---

- **評価（ひょうか）** — kango suru-verb/noun, "evaluation, assessment, rating." 評 (evaluate) + 価 (value). Used for products, people's work, performance. Collocation: 評価が高い/低い. [JLPT N2]
- **映画（えいが）に対（たい）する** — 映画 (film) + に対する (toward, regarding). 対する is a rentai-kei form of 対する. [JLPT N2]
- **世間（せけん）の評価（ひょうか）は高（たか）い** — 世間 (public, society) + の評価 + は高い (is high). [JLPT N2]

**The department manager instructed Tanaka to submit the meeting report.**

---

- **指示（しじ）** — kango suru-verb/noun, "instruction, direction, indication." 指 (point) + 示 (show). Pattern: 〜に〜よう指示する ("instruct someone to do ~"). [JLPT N2]
- **部長（ぶちょう）は田中（たなか）さんに** — 部長 (department manager) + は (topic) + 田中さん + に (target of instruction). [JLPT N3]
- **会議（かいぎ）のレポートを出（だ）すよう** — 会議 (meeting) + レポート (report) + を出す (to submit) + よう (volitional/quotative, "to"). [JLPT N3]
- **指示（しじ）した** — 指示する (他動詞, "to instruct") + た (past). [JLPT N2]

**I was ignored when I tried to talk to them.**

---

- **無視（むし）** — kango suru-verb/noun, "ignoring, disregard." 無 (no) + 視 (looking). Pattern: 〜を無視する ("ignore ~"). Also passive: 無視される ("to be ignored"). [JLPT N2]
- **話（はな）しかけたのに** — 話しかける (他動詞, "to speak to, to address") + た (past) + のに (despite/concessive). "Even though I spoke to them..." Counterpart: 話しかけられる (passive). [JLPT N3]
- **無視（むし）された** — 無視する + された (passive past). "Was ignored." This is a direct passive (adversative nuance: speaker's feelings were hurt). [JLPT N2]

**You must not use other people's things without permission.**

---

- **無断（むだん）** — kango noun/adverb, "without permission, unauthorized." 無 (no) + 断 (declaration/permission). Pattern: 無断で ("without permission"). Common compounds: 無断欠席 (unauthorized absence), 無断使用 (unauthorized use). [JLPT N2]
- **無断（むだん）で** — 無断 + で (manner). "Without permission." [JLPT N2]
- **人（ひと）の物（もの）を使（つか）ってはいけない** — 人の物 (other people's things) + を使う (to use) + てはいけない (must not). [JLPT N4]

"I'm counting on you to finish this work by tomorrow." "Understood."

---

- **承知（しょうち）** — kango suru-verb/noun, "understanding, consent, compliance." 承 (receive) + 知 (know). Used as a humble/polite response: 承知しました = "Understood / Will do." More formal than 分かりました. [JLPT N2]
- **この仕事（しごと）、明日（あした）までに頼（たの）みます** — この仕事 (this work) + 明日までに (by tomorrow) + 頼みます (I request/entrust). 頼む is 他動詞. [JLPT N3]
- **承知（しょうち）しました** — 承知する (humble) + しました (polite past). Standard workplace acknowledgment. [JLPT N2]

**I cannot accept the company's way of doing things.**

---

- **納得（なっとく）** — kango suru-verb/noun, "understanding and acceptance, being convinced." 納 (settle) + 得 (gain). Not just understanding intellectually, but feeling emotionally satisfied. Pattern: 〜に納得できない ("cannot accept ~"). Chinese 納得 is a true friend. [JLPT N2]
- **会社（かいしゃ）のやり方（かた）には** — 会社 (company) + の + やり方 (way of doing) + には (target of acceptance). [JLPT N3]
- **納得（なっとく）できない** — 納得する + できない (negative potential). "Cannot be convinced/accept." [JLPT N2]

**Children have doubts/questions about various things.**

---

- **疑問（ぎもん）** — kango noun, "doubt, question, uncertainty." 疑 (doubt) + 問 (ask). Pattern: 〜に疑問を持つ ("have doubts about ~"). Chinese 疑問 is a true friend. [JLPT N2]
- **子どもは** — 子ども (children) + は (topic). [JLPT N5]
- **いろいろなことに** — いろいろな (various) + こと (things) + に (target). [JLPT N4]
- **疑問（ぎもん）を持（も）つ** — 疑問 (doubt) + を持つ (他動詞, "to have, to hold"). [JLPT N3]

**Guess the other person's feelings.**

---
